title: GDP per capita, 1600-2015
claim_summary: Selected countries and the world became much richer, with uneven timing and levels.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser 2016c, based on data from the World Bank and from Maddison Project 2014.
notes: The selected countries and line ordering broadly match the book, but current Maddison 2020/OWID data are not the cited Maddison Project 2014/World Bank 2016 vintage. Remaining differences are not typography-only.
